fightSong.title: Feed the Starter
fightSong.lyrics: From the wharf to the hill, we rise with the tide / Fermented in fog, with sourdough pride / Feed the starter, watch us grow / Sourdoughs rising, here we go!

stadium.name: The Starter
stadium.tradition: The Mother Dough — a 147-year-old sourdough starter is kept in a climate-controlled vault under the 50-yard line. A 'Dough Keeper' (rotating local baker) feeds it pre-game. If the Sourdoughs win, fans get a piece of game-day bread.

fanCulture.description: Fans bring their own starters to games in mason jars. After interceptions, the jumbotron shows time-lapse fermentation. They don't boo — they 'express concern about the process.' Very polite, very deadly.
fanCulture.tailgate: Artisanal everything. Someone is definitely brewing kombucha in a parking lot.

rivalries.name: The California Cold War
rivalries.narrative: LA Traffic Jams vs SF Sourdoughs. It's tech money vs old money, freeways vs ferries, 8 hours in traffic vs 8 hours proofing. We hate them perfectly.

rivalries.name: The Fog Bowl
rivalries.narrative: Seattle grunge vs SF sourdough. Both cities are damp, both think they're more authentic. Game is always in December, always miserable, always great.

paAnnouncer.firstDownCall: First down... and the dough has risen!

cityFlavor: Gold rush, tech rush, always rushing. We invented the fortune cookie, the martini, and the art of being quietly superior about bread.
